text.WEB: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

citations.context: We can't know if that person is apostate or not. Only God knows his heart. Look at James chapter 5, verses 19 and 20. James says, My brethren, if anyone among you wanders from the truth and someone brings him back, let him know that whoever brings back a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.

text.KJV: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
text.WEB: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
